result_text:
Promotions now carry an optional `description`, and it comes back from all seven places you listed. The full offline test suite passes (`mvn -q -o test`), but I did not add a test that checks the description text itself, so that path is verified by reading the code, not by a run.

What changed:

- **`schema.sql`**: new nullable `description VARCHAR(200)` column on `promotion`.
- **`model/Promotion.java`**: `description` added as the last record component, so existing positional constructions gain one argument.
- **`DataStore.java`**: `createPromotion` inserts the description and returns it. `findPromotionByCode`, `listPromotionsActiveOn`, `listPromotionsActiveOnInRegion`, `listPromotionsByCategory`, `findBestPromotion` and `listUnusedPromotions` select it and pass it through.
- **`service/PromotionService.java`**: new overload `createPromotion(code, discountPercent, startDate, endDate, category, description)`. A blank description is stored as null. The existing five-argument method delegates with no description, so the current callers and tests are unchanged.

I did not commit.
